scope: Signed-intent deployment/runtime observations, bounded waits and durable candidate caches

development_node.qualification: isolated documented development profile; public fixture funds

limitations: Direct signed CREATE only; factory artifacts and existing-address-only code waits are separate.
Runtime is observed at inclusion-block end, not authenticated by a consensus proof.
The node is the documented isolated development profile, not unmodified/testnet acceptance.
Failures, empty/mismatched code and timeouts never release nonce claims or trigger submission.
